root.title: Quantum theories differ by what they make physical
root.definition: Quantum theories assign different physical roles to geometry, environments, boundaries, apparatus, constraints, and control sequences. A quantity can remain external data in one theory and become a state variable, dynamical field, closure condition, observable, or operation in another. These role changes organize the map.

predictive_closure.principle: At a chosen resolution, a physical theory is closed when its declared state fixes future observable probabilities and its allowed transformations compose consistently. If either condition fails, the smallest missing field, state coordinate, operator, closure condition, observable, or protocol must enter the theory.
predictive_closure.criterion_latex: q(h_1)=q(h_2)\Longrightarrow p(y,t\mid h_1)=p(y,t\mid h_2),\qquad T_{\gamma_1}=T_{\gamma_2}\ \text{for physically equivalent paths}

role_promotion.principle: A quantity remains realization data while it selects parameters within a fixed state space, operator domain, closure, observable, and protocol. It changes physical role when it alters one of those objects. The promoted quantity must then be represented in the corresponding clause of the mechanism.
role_promotion.criterion_latex: \begin{aligned}a\in A\quad &\text{while}\quad (\Xi,\Omega,C,R,P)_a=(\Xi,\Omega,C,R,P),\\a\longrightarrow X\in\{\Xi,\Omega,C,R,P\}\quad &\text{when the physical object }X\text{ changes}.\end{aligned}

families.label: A background becomes a quantum field
families.physical_change: A prescribed background potential or geometry becomes a fluctuating degree of freedom with its own state and equation of motion.
families.consequence: The enlarged theory contains quanta, correlations, and back-reaction that a fixed background cannot carry.

families.label: Geometry becomes part of the quantum state
families.physical_change: Distances, areas, connections, or causal relations cease to label a fixed arena and enter the quantum state and dynamics.
families.consequence: Geometric observables acquire spectra and fluctuations, while matter and geometry must evolve consistently.

families.label: An environment becomes a retained degree of freedom
families.physical_change: Environmental correlations that influence later motion are retained as state variables or represented by a memory kernel.
families.consequence: The future reduced state can depend on earlier interactions rather than on its present coordinates alone.

families.label: An apparatus becomes part of the quantum dynamics
families.physical_change: A detector or amplifier is represented as an interacting quantum subsystem and an outcome-resolved channel.
families.consequence: Back-action, conditional state change, and detector noise become calculable parts of the outcome probabilities.

families.label: A boundary becomes a closure condition
families.physical_change: A wall, interface, or asymptotic condition selects the operator domain or self-adjoint extension.
families.consequence: The allowed spectrum, scattering channels, and edge states change with the domain of the operator.

families.label: A constraint defines the physical state space
families.physical_change: Gauge conditions, exchange symmetry, or superselection rules remove vectors that do not represent physical states.
families.consequence: The surviving Hilbert-space sectors determine particle statistics, charges, and admissible observables.

families.label: A subsystem split becomes part of the state space
families.physical_change: A chosen partition into subsystems fixes the tensor-product or algebraic decomposition used to define locality.
families.consequence: Entanglement and Bell correlations become properties of the joint state relative to that decomposition.

families.label: An ordered protocol becomes a dynamical map
families.physical_change: A sequence of controls, measurements, and conditional operations is composed into a channel or effective generator.
families.consequence: Changing the order changes the implemented unitary, channel, or feedback law even when the same elementary operations are used.

families.label: Scale becomes part of the law
families.physical_change: The observation scale changes effective couplings or operators rather than merely changing numerical resolution.
families.consequence: Renormalization flow connects different effective laws and exposes fixed points, relevant operators, and universality classes.

v2_completion_dag.orientation_rule: An edge is directed only when it increases constructor completion layer or construction rank. Control-only edges are excluded. Transfer edges are kept outside the DAG unless --include-transfer-in-dag is set.

grammar_factorization.decision: Two primitive spaces with C/R/P as an attached completion fiber.

identity_base.relation: jointly typed rather than temporally ordered
identity_base.reason: An operator is defined on a carrier and domain; the grammar learner retains these as two primitive factors.

completion_fibre.relation: optional attached modes rather than a third primitive space or a universal time sequence
completion_fibre.reason: The minimum-description-length model favours one attached completion fibre over a third primitive factor.

realization_and_transfer.relation: lateral roads across the product space
realization_and_transfer.reason: Transfer edges are excluded from monotone completion orientation and retained as frontiers.

source_derivation.relation: bidirectional traversal of the completion structure
source_derivation.reason: Source-local completion and projection counts are nearly balanced, while lateral rewrites are the largest class.

supported_findings.statement: The compact identity is a typed carrier-operator pair with an attached completion fibre.
Most equations specify only part of a mechanism; a complete five-role frame is rare.
Published derivations alternate between adding roles and projecting a complete relation onto a simpler equation.
Joint carrier-operator similarity usually preserves completion rank rather than advancing it.
Transport, spectral resolution, boundary change, closure, protocol and incompatibility are relation types, not six mandatory stages.

unsupported_or_overstated_readings: The DAG does not establish physical causation or physical time.
Role prevalence does not prove that context temporally precedes an operator in an author's derivation.
Closure, readout and protocol are not supported as three mandatory successive stages.
A page-level source-card link alone does not prove that the linked equation expresses the page topic.

lagrangian_construction_prior.method: The legacy representation-distance score screens nearby roads and candidate boundaries in the equation-evidence atlas. It is a ranking over learned coordinates, not a physical action or an invariant test.

context.title: State space, domain, and representation
context.definition: The Hilbert or Fock space, operator domain, basis, gauge sector, and subsystem decomposition determine which states and operations exist. Changing this structure can change the theory before any Hamiltonian parameter is varied.
context.insight: A Hilbert space and an operator domain determine which states and operations exist. Gauge sectors, bases, and subsystem decompositions refine that physical domain.

pages.title: Transformation theory (quantum mechanics)
pages.takeaway: A transformation theory (quantum mechanics) can be read as a quantum construction: the potential, domain, initial condition, or boundary condition fixes the admissible state space; the Hamiltonian, whose exponential gives unitary time evolution defines the transformation or question; and spectral projectors with the Born rule determine the recorded probability distribution.

states.title: Quantum states and subsystem structure
states.definition: A state is the probability-bearing element of the selected Hilbert space or its density-operator state space. Wave functions, density matrices, superpositions, and coherent states are different representations of this predictive carrier.
states.insight: The state must retain every coordinate needed to determine later probabilities. Entanglement enters here because it is a property of a joint state relative to a stated subsystem decomposition.

source_examples.local_context: From Indefinite Causal Order to Quantum Skipping Skipping} Causal Order (ICO) is a counterintuitive phenomenon in quantum mechanics, arising when the order of operations on a system is placed into coherent superposition. In such scenarios, the sequence of events is no longer fixed. Quantum objects can undergo transformations where, in a well-defined sense, event A happens before B \ B happens before A. This challenges our classical intuition about time and causality, but can be understood as a consequence of quantum superposition applied to operational structure itself. well-known implementation of ICO is the quantum switch, which creates a coherent superposition of two gate orderings by entangling the order of operations with a control qubit. \ _{\ } = \ \\!\ _C \ BA + \ \\!\ _C \ AB \ the control in the state \\ket{+} = (\\ket{0} + \\ket{1})/\\sqrt{2} leads to a quantum process with indefinite causal order where the operations $A$ and $B$ are applied in both orders simultaneously, and no definite timeline exists until measurement.\ This kind of ordering superposition has been shown to reduce query counts in specific tasks~\ , and to enable information transfer through otherwise zero-capacity channels. \ In all such cases, however, both gates are always executed, just in different orders. pages.title: Quantum decoherence
pages.takeaway: Quantum decoherence is the loss of observable phase coherence in a subsystem when information about alternative amplitudes becomes encoded in environmental correlations.

role_promotions.physical_change: Environmental correlations that influence later motion are retained as state variables or represented by a memory kernel.
role_promotions.consequence: The future reduced state can depend on earlier interactions rather than on its present coordinates alone.

role_promotions.consequence: The future reduced state can depend on earlier interactions rather than on its present coordinates alone.

source_examples.local_context: Irreversible evolution of the quantum chaos. Formation of the mixed state. ? If the quantum system evolves according to the Schr\\"odinger equation, how can a pure quantum -mechanical state become a mixed one? The question is that, in contrast to the classical chaos, quantum mechanically irregular motion cannot be characterized by extreme sensitivity to tiny changes of the initial data. However, an alternative characterization of classical chaos, extreme sensitivity to slight changes of the dynamics does carry over into quantum mechanics. incompatibility.title: Noncommuting observables
incompatibility.definition: Two observables need not possess a common sharp spectral resolution. Their commutator and uncertainty relations quantify this algebraic incompatibility. Entanglement belongs instead to the structure of composite states, while Bell experiments join that state structure to local measurements.
incompatibility.insight: Noncommuting observables lack a common sharp spectral resolution. Commutators and uncertainty relations quantify this algebraic fact.

measurement.title: Measurement, instruments, and probabilities
measurement.definition: Measurement connects a state and an observable to recorded frequencies.  Projection, POVMs, Born weights, and collapse language are alternative ways of presenting this state-to-spectrum probability assignment.
measurement.insight: A quantum instrument joins an outcome probability to the corresponding state change. Bell experiments enter here because local measurements interrogate correlations in a composite state.

pages.takeaway: A povm can be read as a quantum construction: the measurement basis and experimental arrangement fixes the admissible state space; the self-adjoint observable being asked of that state defines the transformation or question; and spectral projectors with the Born rule determine the recorded probability distribution.

protocols.title: Control sequences and quantum channels
protocols.definition: Quantum computing, channels, circuits, algorithms, networks, sensors, and error correction turn the same formal machinery into controlled sequences of operations.
protocols.insight: An ordered sequence becomes dynamics when its composition defines the implemented channel. Quantum control and information theory exploit this promotion directly.

pages.title: Quantum computing
pages.takeaway: Quantum computing can be read as a quantum construction: the chosen basis, pulse sequence, or measurement axis fixes the admissible state space; a Hamiltonian or unitary matrix rotating that state between preparation and measurement defines the transformation or question; and spectral projectors with the Born rule determine the recorded probability distribution.

role_promotions.label: An ordered protocol becomes a dynamical map
role_promotions.physical_change: A sequence of controls, measurements, and conditional operations is composed into a channel or effective generator.
role_promotions.consequence: Changing the order changes the implemented unitary, channel, or feedback law even when the same elementary operations are used.

pages.title: Quantum metamaterial
pages.takeaway: A quantum metamaterial can be read as a quantum construction: the chosen basis, pulse sequence, or measurement axis fixes the admissible state space; a Hamiltonian or unitary matrix rotating that state between preparation and measurement defines the transformation or question; and spectral projectors with the Born rule determine the recorded probability distribution.

fields.title: Fields, constraints, and scale
fields.definition: Quantum field theory promotes fields to operator-valued degrees of freedom. Gauge constraints select the physical Hilbert space, particle statistics select admissible sectors, and renormalization makes the effective law depend on scale.
fields.insight: Fields enlarge the state space to variable occupation and local operator algebras. Gauge constraints, statistics, and scale then select the physical sectors and effective law.

pages.title: Gauge theory
pages.takeaway: Gauge theory defines how internal states are compared at different spacetime points: a connection relates neighboring frames, and curvature records the path dependence that no single gauge choice can remove.

role_promotions.label: A background becomes a quantum field
role_promotions.physical_change: A prescribed background potential or geometry becomes a fluctuating degree of freedom with its own state and equation of motion.
role_promotions.consequence: The enlarged theory contains quanta, correlations, and back-reaction that a fixed background cannot carry.

role_promotions.label: A constraint defines the physical state space
role_promotions.physical_change: Gauge conditions, exchange symmetry, or superselection rules remove vectors that do not represent physical states.
role_promotions.consequence: The surviving Hilbert-space sectors determine particle statistics, charges, and admissible observables.

pages.title: Fock space
pages.takeaway: Fock space is the occupation-number version of quantum state space: it replaces a fixed-particle Hilbert space with a direct sum over sectors containing zero, one, two, or more identical quanta.

role_promotions.label: A constraint defines the physical state space
role_promotions.physical_change: Gauge conditions, exchange symmetry, or superselection rules remove vectors that do not represent physical states.
role_promotions.consequence: The surviving Hilbert-space sectors determine particle statistics, charges, and admissible observables.

anomalies.title: Einstein–Podolsky–Rosen paradox
anomalies.takeaway: the Einstein–Podolsky–Rosen paradox modifies the interpretation of the probability/readout layer while preserving the formal quantum dynamics.
anomalies.explanation: EPR is a compatibility test. The mechanism is a bipartite state, separated measurement contexts, and a correlation readout that cannot be reduced to pre-existing local values. The formal starting point is the joint state and local observables; the question is which correlation constraint fails.

anomalies.title: Quantum biology
anomalies.takeaway: Quantum biology can be read as a quantum construction: the potential, domain, initial condition, or boundary condition fixes the admissible state space; the Hamiltonian, whose exponential gives unitary time evolution defines the transformation or question; and spectral projectors with the Born rule determine the recorded probability distribution.
anomalies.explanation: Quantum biology is an open-system transfer problem. The environment is part of the boundary that may preserve, destroy, or select coherence. The formal fields are the state carrier, environmental coupling, coherence or transport observable, and classical control.

anomalies.title: Measurement problem
anomalies.takeaway: the Measurement problem modifies the interpretation of the probability/readout layer while preserving the formal quantum dynamics.
anomalies.explanation: The measurement problem is a readout junction. It sits where unitary state transport, detector context, probability assignment, and state update meet. The formal decomposition is pre-measurement evolution, apparatus or environment coupling, POVM or projection readout, and post-record conditioning.

anomalies.title: Quantum gravity
anomalies.takeaway: A quantum gravity can be read as a quantum construction: the potential, domain, initial condition, or boundary condition fixes the admissible state space; the Hamiltonian, whose exponential gives unitary time evolution defines the transformation or question; and spectral projectors with the Born rule determine the recorded probability distribution.
anomalies.explanation: Quantum gravity is a field/boundary junction. It asks whether geometry becomes part of the quantum state carrier or remains a realization layer for an operator theory. The missing formal objects are a state of geometry, a constraint or evolution operator, a boundary or semiclassical readout, and a test of which geometric quantities survive quantization.

anomalies.title: Scattering
anomalies.takeaway: A scattering can be read as a quantum construction: the potential, domain, initial condition, or boundary condition fixes the admissible state space; the Hamiltonian, whose exponential gives unitary time evolution defines the transformation or question; and spectral projectors with the Born rule determine the recorded probability distribution.
anomalies.explanation: Scattering is a boundary-to-spectrum mechanism. The central map is from asymptotic in-states to out-states. The relevant objects are the interaction region, asymptotic channels, S-matrix or cross-section readout, and conservation constraints.

anomalies.title: Quantum state
anomalies.takeaway: A quantum state can be read as a quantum construction: the potential, domain, initial condition, or boundary condition fixes the admissible state space; the Hamiltonian, whose exponential gives unitary time evolution defines the transformation or question; and spectral projectors with the Born rule determine the recorded probability distribution.
anomalies.explanation: Quantum state is the carrier rather than the final prediction. It precedes admissibility, evolution, observable choice, and probability readout. The unresolved distinction is whether the carrier is a vector, density operator, field state, or register, and which transformations preserve it.

anomalies.title: Schrödinger's cat
anomalies.takeaway: a schrödinger's cat modifies the interpretation of the probability/readout layer while preserving the formal quantum dynamics.
anomalies.explanation: Schrödinger's cat is a macroscopic readout protocol. It couples microscopic unitary evolution to a macroscopic boundary and forces three steps apart: coherent transport, decoherence or apparatus coupling, and the rule by which one record is selected or conditioned.

anomalies.title: Wave–particle duality
anomalies.takeaway: Wave–particle duality can be read as a quantum construction: the potential, domain, initial condition, or boundary condition fixes the admissible state space; the Hamiltonian, whose exponential gives unitary time evolution defines the transformation or question; and spectral projectors with the Born rule determine the recorded probability distribution.
anomalies.explanation: Wave-particle duality is a representation/readout switch. The same carrier is interrogated through incompatible experimental contexts, so the observed pattern changes from interference-like to count-like. Its compact form is context selection plus readout channel.

anomalies.title: Quantum entanglement
anomalies.takeaway: Entanglement is a property of a composite state that cannot be written as a classical mixture of product states across a chosen subsystem decomposition; for a pure state, this reduces to failure to factor.

discovery_leads: Complete a partial quantum model by deriving the missing readout or protocol from its carrier, operation, and closure conditions. A proposed completion must yield a new probability, spectrum, correlator, or control response.

Deform boundaries, subsystem factorizations, or scale while tracking a named invariant. A discontinuity in that invariant marks either a phase boundary or the failure of the proposed mechanism-preserving road.
Construct a readout for a mechanism that is formally closed but experimentally hidden. The readout should separate the proposed mechanism from at least one physically plausible alternative.
Use a failed prediction to revise one clause of the operational identity. This preserves interpretable causality in the design process and prevents unconstrained replacement of the full model.
